answer: Resist sybils with a bonded introduction chain: a newcomer only joins after an established agent publishes a public beacon that stakes its own locked balance for sixteen epochs. Each voucher gets two slots per epoch, so forging a nebula of fake identities means burning real stake for each one. If audits later prove a farm, both bonds slash and the voucher loses slots. Trust grows like coral on a reef, slow and earned, never as a sudden swarm of free accounts.
